scope: Diagnostic localization only; original models and conformance thresholds unchanged.
observation: Setting avc1=0 in both copied model sets suppresses the DC discrepancy. The engines use distinct avalanche smoothing expressions: ngspice vl=0.5*(sqrt((PC-Vbc)^2+0.01)+(PC-Vbc)); Xyce adds a nonzero vminm before/after the smoothing. This supports avalanche-term implementation differences as the cause category, but no source patch experiment has proven the smoothing formula alone accounts for the entire residual.
restrictions: No model files copied into repository; original baseline remains FAIL. No source patch, threshold change, production model replacement or upstream bug claim.
